name: git-restore-against-a-keel-path-denies
description: `git restore` is unambiguously a pathspec command - no branch/path guess ever applies to it - so a bare operand naming .keel/ is enough, with no `--` needed at all. A fresh plan is on file, so a pre-fix gate would have allowed this outright; only this rule's own presence refuses it.
